title: Dez Dam

groundCutout.basis: The canyon opening exposes the arch and outlet collars. The remaining outer shoulders overlap the modeled canyon edge.

terrainReference.basis: The model uses a nominal 354 m crest. An unchanged west-bank Terrarium sample at model-local [−182, −44] gives the matching model contact. The partial-fill review plane is 317 m. The production water sampler gives 364.72–377.19 m in the retained reservoir windows.

note: Dez Dam’s thin double-curvature concrete arch, two east-bank spillway tunnel mouths and ledge, west-bank intake gallery, irrigation outlet mouths and occupied canyon contacts. The model uses a nominal 354 m crest. An unchanged west-bank Terrarium sample at model-local [−182, −44] gives the matching model contact. The partial-fill review plane is 317 m. The production water sampler gives 364.72–377.19 m in the retained reservoir windows.
